📣Eid Ul Fitr Announcement📣

Dear Respected Community Members,

🕌Masjid Attarbiya, Nechells is delighted to extend a warm invitation to you for the celebration of Eid ul Fitr, which will take place on Wednesday, 10th of April 2024.

Eid prayers will take place in the masjid ONLY‼️

 🕌First prayer will be starting promptly at 8am, followed by a speech by Sh. Anas Dayib (English).🔊

🕌Second prayer at 9am followed by a speech by Sh. Abdulqadir Hashi (Arabic).🔊

 🏁We kindly urge all brothers and sisters to arrive early to partake in this joyous occasion.

📢In accordance with safety guidelines we kindly request all attendees to bring their own prayer mats, and carry a bag for their shoes.

🚗As tomorrow is a working day, we ask for your cooperation in ensuring that access to the masjid is not obstructed. Please be considerate of others, especially the businesses opposite the masjid, and refrain from blocking any cars or access points.

🌙Rabbana Taqabbal Siyaamana wa Qiyaamana wa Ruku’ana wa Sujoodana wa Kulli A’maalina fi Shahri-Ramadhan, Ameen.🤲🏼

🌙May Allah (SWT) accept our fasting, prayers, worship, and all our good deeds performed during the month of Ramadan.🤲🏼

🌙 As we approach the end of this blessed month, let us remember those who are suffering around the globe in our prayers. May Allah (SWT) assist them in their time of need. Ameen.🤲🏼

🌙 Eid Mubarak to everyone from the committee of Masjid Attarbiya, Nechells. ‎تقبل منا ومنكم صالح الأعمال وكل عام وانتم بخير🤲🏼

We look forward to celebrating this joyous occasion with you inshallah.
